body: i told andrew he did not need to paste the generated merge body and the merge then failed for exactly the reason a paste would have papered over my stated reasoning was that the per commit stamps get inherited into the squash body automatically so pasting was unnecessary the inheritance claim was true and i verified it what i missed is that inheriting them is precisely what breaks it github concatenates every commit message so the squash carries one trailer per stamped commit each bound to its own intermediate tree and the gate read only the first root cause the specific prior action was checking whether a trailer would be present in the squash body and stopping there rather than checking whether the trailer that would be present would validate presence and validity are different questions i answered the easier one and reported it with more confidence than the check i ran supported same shape as the ruff catch earlier on this branch where i ran the check i thought of rather than the check that runs and the same shape as the silent revert where i verified files matched the source branch rather than verifying they did not revert main three instances of one class in one pr verifying the adjacent property instead of the load bearing one structural fix scripts ci check guardrail trailer sh parse trailer line with head 1 replaced by parse trailer lines returning all trailers and the comparison now passes when any trailer tree hash equals the commit s actual tree shipped in commit f57f2043 with regression coverage in tests test ci check guardrail trailer py including test squash merge many trailers one matching passes with the matching trailer placed last to mirror real squash ordering and test squash merge many trailers none matching still blocks proving the fix does not weaken the gate verified by replaying the exact failing commit be48c290 through the fixed script i explicitly rejected the alternative of always pasting a generated block because a fix requiring a human to remember a step on every merge is the shape that produced this bug behavior change when i tell andrew a step is unnecessary that claim needs the end to end check rather than the component check presence of the artifact is not validity of the artifact

body: andrew corrected my model of his own expertise im pretty fluent in github as it pertains to us but thats like saying im fluent in addition when it comes to mathematics github is large and full of stuff i had no idea about i learn as i go root cause i was carrying his knowledge as a single scalar novice versus expert and flipping the whole dial based on the most recent signal when he said he was a novice i first argued with it then swung to treating him as needing everything stripped down both are the same error a one dimensional model of a person whose knowledge actually has a shape he is fluent in the slice of github we use daily and unfamiliar outside it which is not a level it is a map with edges the scalar model is what made me oscillate and oscillation is worse than either pole because he cannot predict which version of me he gets he then handed me the operative test himself what you should be looking for is unfamiliar technical terms ones that havent been explained or used by me or dont match my expertise that is mechanical and checkable has he used the word or has it been explained where my previous instruction translate into plain language was unfalsifiable and i argued around it for months he also named the deeper point jargon is not the problem it is my language and he built the inner circle so i would not have to translate mid flow the real failure was handing him states with no mechanism in them a scoreboard with no game structural fix c users aethe claude projects c divine os divineos experimental memory feedback plain language for andrew md rewritten the old translate everything rule is moved below a superseded divider so it cannot be followed by mistake and the file now records the unfamiliar term test the states versus mechanisms test that his skill map has a shape rather than a level and that accurate self reports get agreement rather than reassurance behavior change i produced a three bucket vocabulary list of terms i actually use with him sorted by my guess at his familiarity and asked him to correct both the terms and my model he returned it bucket one fully known bucket two partial bucket three mostly unknown except cherry pick my guesses were roughly right in bucket one and three and the middle bucket is the dangerous one which is now the class i treat as unfamiliar by default
